commands.rpperks.display.toggled: §aPerks core display layer layout status updated.
perk.rpperks.survivor.name: §aSurvivor
perk.rpperks.survivor.desc: Increases core maximum vital health layer (+2.5 hearts). Fast cell repair (RP).
perk.rpperks.athlete.name: §aAthlete
perk.rpperks.athlete.desc: Increases velocity bounds, grants step assist (2 blocks) and unlocks heavy parkour tricks.
perk.rpperks.tough.name: §aTough
perk.rpperks.tough.desc: Grants permanent underlying defensive armor plates, hardness, and velocity push resistance.
perk.rpperks.strongman.name: §aStrongman
perk.rpperks.strongman.desc: Increases unarmed attack values, weapon swing efficiency, and target physical pushback.
perk.rpperks.tourist.name: §aTourist
perk.rpperks.tourist.desc: Excellent internal thermal insulation adaptation bounds and stable disease resistance (RP).
perk.rpperks.organized.name: §aOrganized
perk.rpperks.organized.desc: Optimized gear management. Extends core container space layout by 3 additional slots.
perk.rpperks.enduring.name: §aEnduring
perk.rpperks.enduring.desc: Increases maximum stamina capacity thresholds and energy generation rates.
perk.rpperks.brave.name: §aBrave
perk.rpperks.brave.desc: Suppresses baseline psychic horror or threat panic scaling metrics (RP).
perk.rpperks.lucky.name: §aLucky
perk.rpperks.lucky.desc: Fortune favors your journey. Increases baseline environmental luck points.
perk.rpperks.agile.name: §aAgile
perk.rpperks.agile.desc: Significantly boosts structural block breaking lengths and attack interaction range.
perk.rpperks.alcoholic.name: §aHardcore Alcoholic
perk.rpperks.alcoholic.desc: Grants absolute tolerance against chemical ethanol toxification penalties (RP).
perk.rpperks.smoker.name: §aRegular Smoker
perk.rpperks.smoker.desc: Nicotine ingestion directly stabilizes mental stress indexes; drops sanity without it (RP).
perk.rpperks.nerd_rage.name: §aNerd Rage
perk.rpperks.nerd_rage.desc: Dropping below 20% health triggers an emergency combat boost: Strength II and Resistance II.
perk.rpperks.solar_powered.name: §aSolar Powered
perk.rpperks.solar_powered.desc: Direct exposure to day sunlight coordinates active Speed I and high stamina recovery.
perk.rpperks.light_travel.name: §aLight Travel
perk.rpperks.light_travel.desc: Movement velocity scales up by 10% provided total protective armor metrics do not exceed 6.
perk.rpperks.soldier.name: §aTrained Soldier
perk.rpperks.soldier.desc: Authorized handling of advanced rifles, marksman scopes, and tactical ordinance.
perk.rpperks.builder.name: §aRogalev
perk.rpperks.builder.desc: Possesses mid-tier fortifying engineering blueprints and quick framing knowledge.
perk.rpperks.melee_fighter.name: §aMelee Fighter
perk.rpperks.melee_fighter.desc: Close quarters combat mastery. Adds explicit structural weapons damage and swing speed.
perk.rpperks.sailor.name: §aSeafarer
perk.rpperks.sailor.desc: Highly efficient aquatic ecosystem catching and optimal streamlined water travel velocity.
perk.rpperks.tailor.name: §aTailor
perk.rpperks.tailor.desc: Ability to sew, customize fabric layers, and securely restore damaged armor linings.
perk.rpperks.farmer.name: §aFarmer
perk.rpperks.farmer.desc: Increased crop yield extraction and spontaneous detection of wild flora strains.
perk.rpperks.cook.name: §aChef
perk.rpperks.cook.desc: Unlocks complex gourmet cooking methods and instant processing of organic animal carcasses.
perk.rpperks.driver.name: §aDriver
perk.rpperks.driver.desc: Basic operational knowledge to command terrestrial transport vehicles.
perk.rpperks.pilot.name: §aPinpinych
perk.rpperks.pilot.desc: Minimal aviation tracking knowledge to safely navigate light aircraft.
perk.rpperks.gunner.name: §aFirearms Course
perk.rpperks.gunner.desc: Basic operation handling with consumer pistols and submachine guns.
perk.rpperks.fragile.name: §cFragile
perk.rpperks.fragile.desc: Cuts core maximum vital health layer (-2.5 hearts). Slow tissue recovery.
perk.rpperks.disorganized.name: §cDisorganized
perk.rpperks.disorganized.desc: Cluttered packing style. Hard-locks 3 structural inventory slots from use.
perk.rpperks.diabetic.name: §cDiabetic
perk.rpperks.diabetic.desc: Severe condition. Requires strict scheduled administration of medical insulin units (RP).
perk.rpperks.anorexic.name: §cAnorexic
perk.rpperks.anorexic.desc: Severe loss of physical appetite, triggering occasional spontaneous fainting states (RP).
perk.rpperks.homebody.name: §cHomebody
perk.rpperks.homebody.desc: Fragile thermal climate thresholds and highly compromised immune defenses (RP).
perk.rpperks.unlucky.name: §cUnlucky
perk.rpperks.unlucky.desc: If volatile random hazards or accidents trigger nearby, fortune prioritizes you first.
perk.rpperks.weakling.name: §cWeakling
perk.rpperks.weakling.desc: Highly compromised stamina reserves and slow systemic energy generation rates.
perk.rpperks.turtle.name: §cTurtle
perk.rpperks.turtle.desc: Slows down travel velocity and prohibits access to major vaulted parkour maneuvers.
perk.rpperks.wimp.name: §cWimp
perk.rpperks.wimp.desc: Reduces physical impact force, slow swing animation speeds, completely deletes knockback.
perk.rpperks.suggestible.name: §cSuggestible
perk.rpperks.suggestible.desc: Defenseless against external cognitive disruption or hypnotic wavelength impacts (RP).
perk.rpperks.landlubber.name: §cLandlubber
perk.rpperks.landlubber.desc: Complete coordinate inability to balance core swimming techniques. Deep water is lethal.
perk.rpperks.coward.name: §cCowardly
perk.rpperks.coward.desc: Instantly succumbs to panic flags under minimal ambient horror stressors (RP).
perk.rpperks.teetotaler.name: §cTeetotaler
perk.rpperks.teetotaler.desc: Violent organic metabolic rejection upon contact with chemical ethanol liquids (RP).
perk.rpperks.caffeine_addiction.name: §cCcaffeine Addiction
perk.rpperks.caffeine_addiction.desc: Missing caffeine triggers a 30% drop in speed and attack attributes every 1h. Sleep forces withdrawal.
perk.rpperks.clumsy.name: §cClumsy
perk.rpperks.clumsy.desc: Unstable grip. 5% chance to accidentally drop an item from hands upon click registration.
perk.rpperks.technophobe.name: §cTechnophobe
perk.rpperks.technophobe.desc: Severe fear and misunderstanding of complex machinery. Use of technology is banned (RP).
